'''Boeus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==History==
A [[Boeus sector campaign|campaign]] was fought in the sector between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The Boeus sector was governed by Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Darvon Jewett]], who later led his sector in joining the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="SW:TRPG2nd" />
